title: 'What will we have left if we stop loving summer?': Heatwaves crush France's season of insouciance
subhead: The heatwave continues across France, with nearly the entire country under an orange alert on Thursday. The recurrence of extreme temperatures has taken a toll on morale, dampening the usual carefree spirit of summer, as residents of Le Perreux and Nogent-sur-Marne, in the Paris region, explained.

title: 'Each time, the suspension of conflict between Israel and its neighbors leaves unanswered the question that caused it'
subhead: In Lebanon, Gaza and Iran, Israel deploys its military power without ever addressing the political issues raised by these conflicts. The decision to always postpone these questions now poses a danger, writes foreign policy analyst Yonatan Touval, in this op-ed for Le Monde.

title: Ryusuke Hamaguchi, director of 'All of a Sudden': 'I tend to create my works from dialogue'
subhead: The filmmaker shares how he drew inspiration from correspondence between a nursing home director and a theater director, who faces terminal cancer. True to his discreet nature, Hamaguchi refuses to make his cinema a reflection of his personal convictions.

title: Finland wants to restore its peatlands to help the environment. And to slow Russian tanks.
subhead: The Nordic country has identified 180,000 hectares of wetlands that, if restored, could benefit not only the climate and biodiversity but also national defense. While the military supports the plan, some environmentalists warn against rushing the process.

subhead: The veteran Russian politician, 63, tried to challenge Vladimir Putin's regime and its war in Ukraine through legal and electoral means. He failed. Facing the threat of arrest, he decided to leave Russia. His interview with Le Monde is his first since arriving in France.

title: 'I can't stand being only breasts. The eyes burn me': Breasts, a tale of men, women and the times
subhead: 'My Breasts and Me' (4/5). Once a symbol of objectifying women, plastic surgery now draws more women practitioners. The #MeToo wave shook up society and patients' expectations have evolved, reshaping boundaries between genders. Le Monde spent weeks behind closed doors in a private breast surgery practice.
